pr_title: Allow a local branch name to be provided when checking out a pull request
pr_body:
And also use the branch `pr/<num>` by default while checking out pull requests

Fixes #835 and #866
pr_comments: Closing this until we come up with a plan in https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/866.

issue_context.title: Allow a local branch name to be provided when checking out a pull request
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

`gh pr checkout` is great, but afterwards I find it hard to recognize the checked out PR in my branch list.

### Proposed solution

If I could pass `-b my-preferred-branch-name` it'd be easier to manage the resulting branches.

Alternatively, perhaps the branch could be prefixed, e.g. `pr-1234-remote-branch-name`.

### Additional context

https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/746#issuecomment-611547027 suggests this as a workaround when the CLI can't determine a viable branch name itself.
comments: Thanks @mislav, if it's okay I'm happy to take a stab at it.

review_comments: Using a more specific alias is safer I feel (Hence added "refs/remotes" to the start)
Removed this, because we are now using `pr/<num>` as the default branch, so we don't need to check for this
Because Go recommends not using else when the if-block is returning (a) value(s)
